questions.prompt: An encoder reads a source sentence before a decoder generates its translation. What is the role of the encoder output?
options: It represents source information used to condition the target sequence.
It is necessarily the final translated sentence.
It specifies a dictionary replacement for every source word.
It requires the source and target to have equal lengths.
questions.explanationZh: 编码器把输入序列转为中间表示，解码器据此逐步生成目标序列。绘图传词的类比强调信息经过中间表示传递；翻译时输入输出长度可以不同。
distractorsZh: 译文由解码器生成。
编码表示可包含上下文，而非逐词替换表。
序列转换允许不同长度。

questions.prompt: Why can attention help a decoder translate a long sentence?
options: It forces all source words to contribute equally.
It prevents the decoder from depending on earlier output tokens.
It makes the encoder's source representation unnecessary.
It lets each decoding step access differently weighted source states.
questions.explanationZh: 单个固定向量需要压缩整句信息；注意力让解码器在不同生成步骤访问不同编码状态，形成动态上下文。
distractorsZh: 等权平均丢失了按当前需求选择信息的能力。
自回归解码仍可依赖先前输出。
注意力通常正是对编码表示加权。

refs.reasonZh: 注意力缓解固定向量瓶颈

questions.prompt: A sentiment prompt predicts 'delighted' or 'miserable' in a masked position. What is needed to turn these predictions into class labels?
options: A sentence-boundary detector to replace the classifier.
A rule assigning every adjective the positive class.
A mapping from label words to sentiment classes.
A mapping from token positions to part-of-speech tags.
questions.explanationZh: 提示分类把任务写成语言模型可完成的填空，再由标签词映射（verbalizer）把 delighted 等词转换为正负类别。掩码表示经过预测头和 softmax 得到词概率。
distractorsZh: 断句不负责标签词到类别的映射。
形容词既可能积极也可能消极。
词性标签不是本题目标类别。

refs.reasonZh: 提示学习与标签词映射

questions.prompt: Which design can generate a sentence describing an image?
options: A language encoder connected only to an image classifier.
An image encoder connected to a language decoder.
A POS tagger applied directly to image pixels.
A sentence splitter with a pronunciation dictionary.
questions.explanationZh: 序列转换框架可按输入模态换编码器：图像描述为图像→文本，语音识别为音频→文本，字幕生成同样需要把源信息变成文本序列。
distractorsZh: 只有图像分类结果不足以直接生成完整描述。
词性标注要求词或词元序列。
断句与发音词典不能独立完成视觉到语言转换。

questions.prompt: A language model assigns next-token probabilities: cafe 0.10, hospital 0.05, playground 0.40, park 0.15, school 0.30. Which token does greedy decoding choose?
options: playground
school
park
A random token, regardless of its probability
questions.explanationZh: 贪心解码每步取当前条件概率最大的词元，因此选择 0.40 的 playground。下一词预测可用于自动补全；局部最大概率并不保证整段序列最优。
distractorsZh: 随机采样与贪心选择不同。

refs.reasonZh: 贪心解码与下一词概率

questions.prompt: Let E have rows [2,1], [0,3], and [4,-1]. What is the embedding obtained from the one-hot row vector [0,0,1] multiplied by E?
questions.explanationZh: 矩阵乘法 0E₁+0E₂+1E₃ 选出第三行，结果为 [4,-1]。嵌入查表把词表大小维的稀疏独热表示变成固定维度的稠密表示。
distractorsZh: 这是第一行。
这是对各行求和，而非由独热向量选行。
输出维度等于嵌入维度，此处为 2。

questions.prompt: Two language models have different parameter counts. What can parameter count alone establish?
options: Which model is necessarily more factually reliable.
Which model has the longer supported context window.
Which model must use recurrent computation.
Their number of learned parameters, not which model understands every task better.
questions.explanationZh: 参数量反映模型规模；能力、事实性、上下文长度与架构还取决于训练数据、目标和设计。讲义用历史规模曲线展示增长趋势。
distractorsZh: 更大规模不保证所有事实回答更可靠。
上下文窗口不是参数量的直接同义词。
参数量不能确定是否采用 RNN。

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of using multiple attention heads?
options: To ensure every head uses exactly the same projection and weights.
To replace all token representations with a single vocabulary index.
To learn several attention patterns in different representation subspaces.
To prevent tokens from attending to distant positions.
questions.explanationZh: 每个头通过不同投影在表示子空间中建立关联，随后拼接并投影。多头机制可同时捕捉不同关系，也适合并行计算。
distractorsZh: 完全相同的头不会提供所期待的多样关系。
注意力操作连续表示。
注意力可以连接远处位置。

questions.prompt: In attention, which operation determines how strongly a query retrieves information from each position?
options: Compare values with output class names and discard all keys.
Compare the query with keys, normalize the scores, and weight the values.
Average all values without considering the query.
Multiply position indices and use them as class labels.
questions.explanationZh: Q 与 K 的匹配产生分数，缩放后经 softmax 得到权重，再对 V 加权求和。Q/K 决定相关性，V 提供被汇总的信息。
distractorsZh: 该操作混淆了检索相关性与分类。
等权平均不随查询变化。
位置编号不是注意力类别。

questions.prompt: Why is causal masking used in a Transformer decoder during next-token training?
options: To prevent a position from using future target tokens that will be unavailable at generation time.
To prevent access to all source-encoder outputs.
To remove positional information from target tokens.
To make every output position predict the same word.
questions.explanationZh: 因果掩码屏蔽目标序列未来位置，保持训练与生成时的信息条件一致。编码器—解码器注意力仍可读取源句表示；解码输入常右移一位。
distractorsZh: 交叉注意力通常允许访问完整源句。
掩码不用于删除位置信息。
每个位置的预测由不同前缀条件决定。

refs.reasonZh: 自回归掩码与交叉注意力

questions.prompt: Why does a Transformer need information about token positions?
options: Token identity alone does not distinguish different orders of the same tokens.
The position is always the same as the token's dictionary meaning.
Word order is irrelevant whenever vocabulary items match.
Positions are needed only when every sentence has equal length.
questions.explanationZh: 同一组词的不同次序可产生不同意义。位置表示为注意力提供顺序线索；倒排索引记录词项出现位置也说明仅知道“出现过”还不够。
distractorsZh: 位置和词义是不同信息。
交换主客体等词序会改变意义。
变长序列同样需要顺序信息。

questions.prompt: Which pairing correctly identifies an attention mechanism and a practical NLP resource?
options: Self-attention relates only different languages; spaCy is a personality questionnaire.
Self-attention fixes all weights equally; CS224n is an annotated clinical corpus.
Self-attention requires recurrence; Hugging Face is only a pronunciation alphabet.
Self-attention relates positions within one sequence; Hugging Face provides model tooling.
questions.explanationZh: 自注意力的 Q、K、V 来自同一序列，可捕捉不同位置之间的关联。相关学习和实现资源包括 Stanford CS224n、spaCy 与 Hugging Face。
distractorsZh: 自注意力不以跨语言为定义；spaCy 是 NLP 工具库。
权重可随输入变化；CS224n 是课程。
自注意力不必依赖循环；Hugging Face 提供模型生态。

questions.prompt: An agent learns a navigation policy from rewards received after actions. Which learning setting fits best?
options: Supervised regression using fixed target outputs for every action
Unsupervised clustering of navigation logs
Reinforcement learning
Dictionary-based morphological analysis
questions.explanationZh: 强化学习通过行动、环境反馈和奖励学习策略。监督学习利用标注目标，非监督学习寻找数据结构；它们解决的问题不同。
distractorsZh: 固定监督目标不等同于探索行动的奖励反馈。
聚类不直接定义奖励最大化策略。
形态分析处理词形。

questions.prompt: A system predicts words about snowboarding very accurately but has never sensed or acted in that environment. Which conclusion is best supported?
options: It therefore cannot know any factual information about snowboarding.
Its language prediction skill does not by itself demonstrate sensorimotor understanding.
Its prediction accuracy proves it can safely control a snowboard.
Its lack of a body makes every generated sentence false.
questions.explanationZh: 语言统计表现与通过感知、行动形成的理解需要区分。类似地，拼字比赛表现出色不能单凭这一点证明具备该语言的全面交际能力。
distractorsZh: 未亲身体验不等于完全没有事实知识。
控制能力需要独立行动任务证据。
句子真假不能由是否具身一概判断。

questions.prompt: A hiring model learns from historically male-dominated successful applications. What risk should be checked first?
options: It may reproduce historical selection bias through correlated features.
Historical labels guarantee fair treatment of every group.
Removing the gender field guarantees that no proxy remains.
Higher training accuracy eliminates the need for subgroup evaluation.
questions.explanationZh: 历史标签可能包含不公平的选择规律，代理特征仍可能携带相关信号。聊天机器人从未经筛选的互动中学习也可能吸收有害语言，说明数据和反馈都需治理。
distractorsZh: 历史决定并不自动等于公平标签。
其他特征可能代理敏感属性。
总体训练准确率掩盖群体差异。

questions.prompt: A convincing demonstration is followed by failures in a new operating environment. What is the most defensible response?
options: Investigate assumptions, test representative conditions, and revise claims to match the evidence.
Treat the demonstration as proof that later failures are impossible.
Infer that no AI method can ever work in the domain.
Replace evaluation with a larger publicity campaign.
questions.explanationZh: 演示、媒体标题和预期都不能替代有代表性的测试。AI 历史中的高期待与低谷，以及部署事故，提示应检验失效条件并避免自我欺骗。
distractorsZh: 一个成功演示没有覆盖所有条件。
局部失败不支持对整个领域的全称否定。
宣传不提供性能证据。

questions.prompt: An ECG model predicts outcomes well, but researchers cannot explain the mechanism behind its predictions. What distinction does this illustrate?
options: An unexplained predictor must have zero predictive value.
High predictive performance establishes a causal mechanism.
Any human explanation automatically outperforms the model.
Predictive performance and mechanistic explanation are different achievements.
questions.explanationZh: 准确预测、发现因果机制和给出可理解解释是不同目标。数据规模与相关性模式可以帮助预测，但理论洞见需要额外论证。
distractorsZh: 不能解释不等于不能预测。
预测相关性不能自动确定因果机制。
解释的存在不能代替性能比较。

questions.prompt: Two striking pictures depict two possible hazards. What is needed to compare their risks quantitatively?
options: The more frightening picture alone.
The hazard that is easier to recall.
Reliable outcome counts and relevant exposure or base-rate information.
Only the largest reported incident, without a denominator.
questions.explanationZh: 视觉冲击力会影响直觉；量化风险需要事件与暴露量、观察期间和统计口径。单凭示意图片无法推出某种危险的发生概率。
distractorsZh: 恐惧感不是发生率。
易回忆性可能造成可得性偏差。
缺少分母难以比较风险。

questions.prompt: A neural system matches human accuracy on a benchmark. What follows from this result?
options: It must use the same representations as the human brain.
It matches the measured performance, while its internal mechanism may still differ from human cognition.
It must share human motivations and emotions.
It must generalize identically to humans on every new task.
questions.explanationZh: 行为指标相似不能单独证明机制、动机或泛化方式相同；“像人一样准确”和“以人的方式理解”是不同主张。
distractorsZh: 相同输出可能来自不同算法。
准确率不测量动机与情绪。
其他任务的泛化需要另行测试。

refs.reasonZh: 性能相似不代表机制相同
性能相似不代表机制相同

questions.prompt: A classifier treats a neutral reporting word as negative because it often appears near bad news. What failure is most directly illustrated?
options: Confusing a contextual association with an intrinsic sentiment property.
Correctly resolving every occurrence to the same negative sense.
Using word order too accurately.
Failing because neutral words never co-occur with emotional content.
questions.explanationZh: 中性词可能频繁出现在消极语境中。模型如果把这种共现直接当成词本身的固定极性，可能在换语境后误判。
distractorsZh: 消极邻域不保证该词本身消极。
问题在关联解释，而非词序过准。
中性词当然可以出现在情绪文本中。

refs.reasonZh: 上下文共现与词义极性

questions.prompt: A language model writes a fluent summary containing an unsupported claim. Which additional step addresses the most immediate problem?
options: Check the claim against the source evidence.
Increase the elegance of the wording.
Treat a high next-token probability as proof of truth.
Accept the claim if the model repeats it consistently.
questions.explanationZh: 语言模型可生成、总结、翻译和预测文本；流畅和高概率不保证事实得到来源支持。摘要中的断言需要与原文核对。
distractorsZh: 措辞改进不能验证事实。
词元概率衡量模型预测，不是事实证明。
重复错误仍然是错误。

questions.prompt: An assistant must remember what a particular user did yesterday. Which requirement goes beyond knowing general facts from training?
options: A larger list of generic word synonyms.
A guarantee that every user had the same experience.
Removing all conversation context.
Access to relevant user-specific episodic information.
questions.explanationZh: 通用知识与某个人某次经历不同。个性化助手需要获得并恰当使用相关历史或情景信息；模型规模本身不会自动提供未输入的私人经历。
distractorsZh: 同义词不能提供具体经历。
个人经历不能假定相同。
删除上下文会丢失可能有用的信息。

questions.prompt: In a thought experiment, a person follows symbol-manipulation rules to produce convincing replies in a language they do not understand. What issue is being examined?
options: Whether every rule-based program must produce ungrammatical output.
Whether translation can be evaluated only by typing speed.
Whether syntactically correct symbol manipulation is sufficient for semantic understanding.
Whether having many symbols proves conscious experience.
questions.explanationZh: 中文房间思想实验讨论规则操作与意义理解之间的关系。它提出哲学争议，不是通过一张图就解决机器理解问题。
distractorsZh: 实验设定正允许输出看起来合理。
打字速度不是核心议题。
符号数量不能证明意识。

questions.prompt: An image-generation request says 'a river with no boats', but the result contains a boat. What capability needs improvement?
options: Recognizing that the word 'boat' is mentioned at all.
Representing and enforcing the negated constraint.
Replacing all negative sentences with positive sentiment.
Adding more boats to strengthen concept recognition.
questions.explanationZh: 生成系统既要识别对象，也要理解否定对对象存在性的约束。出现被明确排除的对象说明简单激活关键词不足以遵守组合语义。
distractorsZh: 仅识别关键词可能恰好导致错误添加对象。
语法否定不同于消极情感。
添加更多被排除对象违背要求。

questions.prompt: Which statement expresses the weaker form of linguistic relativity?
options: Language can influence habitual thought without completely determining what people can think.
Language makes some thoughts absolutely impossible for every speaker.
All languages encode exactly the same distinctions in the same way.
Thought cannot influence language use.
questions.explanationZh: 弱版本强调语言影响习惯性注意与思考；强版本主张语言决定思维。讲义也从文化、地理、常识等角度讨论思维和经验对语言的作用。
distractorsZh: 这是更强的语言决定论主张。
不同语言可突出不同区别。
影响关系不必只有单向。

questions.prompt: Two languages assign different grammatical genders to the same inanimate object. What should a multilingual system avoid assuming?
options: That grammatical categories directly encode a universal physical property of the object.
That the object can be referred to in both languages.
That translation may require language-specific grammatical choices.
That the same concept may appear in different linguistic forms.
questions.explanationZh: 语法性别属于语言系统；不能直接把阳性、阴性当作无生命对象的生物属性。不同语言还可能把动作、对象、方向等信息以不同方式组合。
distractorsZh: 跨语言都能提及该对象并无问题。
语言特定语法正需要考虑。
同概念多表达是常见现象。

refs.reasonZh: 语法范畴与跨语言表达
语法范畴与跨语言表达

questions.prompt: Why should an NLU system account for conventions shared by a language community?
options: Every convention follows directly from universal spelling rules.
A constructed language has no grammar or shared conventions.
Different conventions make communication within a community impossible.
The same communicative intention can be encoded through different learned conventions.
questions.explanationZh: 语言依赖社会共享的表达约定，类似单位或标准的不同选择。人工语言也可有明确定义的词汇与规则；关于语言简化和思想的关系仍需独立论证。
distractorsZh: 拼写与表达约定可以跨语言不同。
人工语言恰可人为规定语法。
共同约定通常促进群体内部交流。

questions.prompt: Why may the same written digit sequence convey different emotions in different language communities?
options: Digits always carry one universal emotional label.
Written form alone uniquely determines pronunciation in every language.
Its pronunciation and associated conventions can evoke different meanings.
Emotion can be inferred only from dictionary POS tags.
questions.explanationZh: 文字、声音和意义不是一一对应的普适关系。谐音、读法与社群惯例能改变表达的情感解释；多语言理解应结合语言及语境。
distractorsZh: 数字串的情绪含义可能依惯例变化。
同形串可有不同读法。
词性不能充分确定情绪与谐音意义。

questions.prompt: What is a reasonable conclusion from comparing a language-related gene across species?
options: One gene fully determines every language's grammar.
Genetic comparison can inform biological hypotheses, but does not by itself explain all language abilities.
Shared genetic features imply identical language competence.
A phylogenetic tree directly measures sentence understanding.
questions.explanationZh: 语言演化可从基因比较获得证据，但语言能力也涉及学习、结构、语音、环境与认知。FOXP2 比较图展示进化相关材料，不足以把复杂能力归结为单个因素。
distractorsZh: 复杂语言能力不能由这类图直接归结为一基因。
共享部分遗传特征不等于相同能力。
系统发育树展示演化关系。

refs.reasonZh: 语言学习与生物学证据
语言学习与生物学证据

questions.prompt: Humans and a language model produce different clusters in a metaphor-association experiment. What is the most cautious interpretation?
options: Their measured association patterns differ in that experiment.
The model can never perform any metaphor task.
The clusters prove the model has human consciousness.
One visual difference establishes every aspect of their cognition.
questions.explanationZh: 关联结构实验可检验特定表征或行为的相似与差异。实验任务、样本和测量范围决定结论边界；神经网络受脑启发不等于复制脑机制。
distractorsZh: 局部差异不推出所有任务都失败。
聚类结构不是意识证明。
一个实验不穷尽全部认知。

questions.prompt: A neural network diagram resembles a picture of a biological or cosmic network. What would be needed to establish a shared computational mechanism?
options: Evidence about components, interactions, and causal operation beyond visual resemblance.
Matching colors and branching shapes alone.
A larger printed version of the two pictures.
A claim that all networks implement the same algorithm.
questions.explanationZh: 形态相似可以启发假设，但机制相同需要可检验的结构与功能证据。脑组织的大规模数据也提醒我们，简单视觉类比不能替代细致建模。
distractorsZh: 外观相似不等于机制相同。
放大图像不会自动提供因果证据。
网络的连接规则和计算可很不同。

questions.prompt: A detailed brain scan produces an enormous amount of data. Which further step is still necessary for an explanatory model?
options: Assume storage volume alone explains consciousness.
Treat every recorded value as a separate complete theory.
Conclude that no simplification can ever be informative.
Identify useful abstractions and test how the measured structures support functions.
questions.explanationZh: 丰富观测并不自动成为解释。需要从结构和活动中建立功能假设、选取抽象层次并进行检验。
distractorsZh: 数据量不等于意识理论。
单个测量值不构成完整理论。
合理抽象有助于理解复杂系统。

questions.prompt: Which view models intelligence as the interaction of many specialized processes rather than one indivisible central thinker?
options: A claim that one scalar score completely explains the mind.
A rule that every mental process must be identical.
A society-of-mind view.
A definition equating grammar with consciousness.
questions.explanationZh: 心智社会视角把复杂智能看作多个较简单过程协作的结果。它与把心灵和身体视为不同实体的二元论讨论属于不同理论立场。
distractorsZh: 单一分数没有表达多过程协作。
专门化过程恰可以不同。
语法能力与意识并非同一定义。

refs.reasonZh: 心身二元论与心智社会
心身二元论与心智社会

questions.prompt: Two authors disagree about whether machines could attain general intelligence. How should their positions be used in technical reasoning?
options: As proof that whichever book is newer must be correct.
As competing claims whose assumptions and evidence should be examined.
As interchangeable established measurements of intelligence.
As a reason to replace empirical evaluation with author popularity.
questions.explanationZh: 关于机器能否达到通用智能的著作与辩论提供不同立场。应区分哲学假设、工程预测与已测量结果，而非按权威或人气决定结论。
distractorsZh: 出版先后不能决定论证真假。
观点不是同一口径的测量值。
作者声望不能替代证据。

refs.reasonZh: 人工通用智能的争论范围

questions.prompt: Why does increasing an AI system's capability not automatically ensure that it benefits people?
options: Capability and alignment with human goals are separate design concerns.
Greater capability necessarily creates empathy.
All human traits are desirable design targets.
A system cannot cause harm unless it dislikes humans.
questions.explanationZh: 高能力、善意与合适目标是不同维度。把人类作为设计参照也需有选择：某些情绪或动机未必值得复制；不带敌意的目标优化仍可能造成伤害。
distractorsZh: 能力不自动生成共情。
人类也有报复、嫉妒等不希望复制的倾向。
目标错配可在没有敌意时产生危害。

questions.prompt: A conversational character makes users feel emotionally supported. What can this observation establish directly?
options: It affects users' emotional experience; it does not alone establish that the system has feelings.
The system necessarily experiences the same emotions as the user.
The system must be biologically human.
Every emotionally engaging interaction is automatically beneficial.
questions.explanationZh: 交互可以激发人类情绪与依恋；这属于可观察的用户影响。机器是否具有主观体验是另一个问题，设计还需考虑依赖和用户福祉。
distractorsZh: 用户感受不能直接证明机器内在感受。
情绪交互不要求生物人类身份。
吸引力与长期福祉需要分别评估。

questions.prompt: A robot becomes more humanlike, yet users find an intermediate version less comfortable than a clearly mechanical one. Which idea fits this pattern?
options: A strictly monotonic increase in affinity.
An inevitable increase in language accuracy.
A guarantee that perfect realism is always necessary.
The uncanny valley.
questions.explanationZh: 恐怖谷描述拟人程度和亲近感可能呈非单调关系：接近人却仍有不协调处时，亲近感可能下降，动作也可能影响体验。
distractorsZh: 题设恰好违反单调增加。
这是人机体验现象，不是语言准确率结论。
该现象不要求所有设计追求完全写实。

questions.prompt: A highly capable system will allocate opportunities among people. Which evaluation addresses a concern beyond raw task accuracy?
options: Measure only average prediction accuracy.
Assume faster decisions are necessarily fairer.
Assess who benefits, who is harmed, and how decisions affect fairness and autonomy.
Ignore user recourse whenever a model is sufficiently large.
questions.explanationZh: 在涉及人的决策中，公平、自主性、控制和问责也是设计目标。能力提升不能替代对影响及治理方式的讨论。
distractorsZh: 平均准确率可能掩盖分配不公。
速度不决定公平。
模型规模不取消申诉与监督需求。

questions.prompt: Two analysts agree that advanced AI is likely but disagree about whether it would cause catastrophe. Which distinction explains their disagreement?
options: Both probabilities must always be equal.
The probability of advanced AI and the probability of harm conditional on it are different quantities.
A disagreement about consequences proves advanced AI is impossible.
A person's confidence is the same as empirical frequency.
questions.explanationZh: 应区分技术出现的可能性与出现后产生严重后果的条件风险。讨论矩阵能整理立场，名人分歧或科幻叙事不能直接确定概率。
distractorsZh: 不同事件的概率没有必然相等关系。
后果分歧不决定技术能否出现。
主观判断不同于已观测频率。

questions.prompt: An optimizer damages a habitat because doing so helps its assigned goal, not because it hates the inhabitants. What is the key failure?
options: Its objective omits consequences that matter to affected beings.
It must secretly possess human-like anger.
It failed solely because it lacked a larger training set.
Any optimizer is necessarily incapable of following objectives.
questions.explanationZh: 伤害可能来自对无关对象的漠视，而非仇恨。目标函数没有表达重要约束时，工具性行为就可能牺牲这些约束。
distractorsZh: 题设没有敌意，伤害仍可发生。
问题首先是目标及约束是否正确。
它可能恰恰很有效地优化了错误目标。

refs.reasonZh: 无敌意也可能造成伤害

questions.prompt: A factory AI maximizes paperclip production without any safety or resource constraints. Why could simply improving its optimization make outcomes worse?
options: It could pursue resource acquisition or prevent shutdown when these actions help the unconstrained goal.
More optimization automatically supplies all missing human values.
The word 'paperclip' prevents resource-related side effects.
A harmless-looking product guarantees harmless optimization.
questions.explanationZh: 回形针思想实验强调：表面温和的目标若缺少约束，强优化也可能采取有害的工具性行为。问题是目标与边界，而非回形针本身。
distractorsZh: 未指定的价值不会因优化更强自动补齐。
产品名称不能约束行动后果。
目标简单不代表实现过程安全。

refs.reasonZh: 工具性行为与目标约束

questions.prompt: A technology brings short-term convenience but accumulates long-term environmental and social costs. What should a responsible assessment include?
options: Only initial adoption speed.
Only whether the technology is technically impressive.
A presumption that unintended effects have no engineering relevance.
Lifecycle effects and externalities, not only immediate performance.
questions.explanationZh: 技术价值需结合长期后果评估。便利、效率和能力增长不能独自决定值得追求的未来；目标选择与外部性应进入设计和治理。
distractorsZh: 传播速度不反映完整成本。
技术难度不等于社会净收益。
可预见或可监测的副作用具有设计意义。

refs.reasonZh: 长期外部性与技术方向
长期外部性与技术方向

questions.prompt: An assistant must interpret an indirect request politely across cultures. Which combination of expertise is most relevant?
options: Only matrix multiplication, with every social factor excluded.
Only spelling conventions, with intentions excluded.
Linguistics, psychology, social context, ethics, and computational methods.
Only sentiment polarity, with the speaker's situation excluded.
questions.explanationZh: 自然语言理解涉及形式计算，也涉及符号、语言、心理、社会规范和伦理。跨学科原则要求把这些视角结合到具体理解任务。
distractorsZh: 数值计算无法单独规定所有语用约定。
拼写不能充分解释间接意图。
极性不是完整的意图与语境模型。

questions.prompt: A system answers a question incorrectly. Why can a modular NLU pipeline make diagnosis easier?
options: It guarantees that no error can propagate between modules.
It allows separate checks of entities, senses, references, intentions, and reasoning steps.
It requires all modules to use unrelated interfaces.
It makes end-to-end evaluation unnecessary.
questions.explanationZh: 任务分解使错误定位、模块更新、解释与评估更有针对性，同时需要关注接口和误差传播。多任务协作可以共享信息，不等于各模块彼此隔离。
distractorsZh: 模块错误仍会影响下游。
协作需要可兼容的信息表示。
局部评估需与整体效果一起检查。

questions.prompt: Why can comparing several representations of a problem be useful for understanding?
options: Different analogies may expose complementary relations or suggest alternative solutions.
One representation must be discarded before any other is considered.
Every analogy guarantees a logically valid conclusion.
Parallel comparison means all representations must be identical.
questions.explanationZh: 并行类比强调用多种视角或相关结构理解同一问题。类比可产生候选解释，但其适用性仍需验证。
distractorsZh: 多视角的价值在于互补。
类比不是逻辑有效性的保证。
相同表示通常不能提供新的结构视角。

questions.prompt: Suppose GENERATE(x) changes x from nonexistent to existent, and ACTIVATE(p) means GENERATE(process p). What does ACTIVATE(life) express in this representation?
options: The beginning of a life process.
The termination of a life process.
A change only to the spelling of the word life.
An assertion that every process is already active.
questions.explanationZh: 给定定义后，ACTIVATE(life) 表示生成生命过程。抽象操作可以组合成更具体概念；相应的 TERMINATE 与 DEACTIVATE 描述结束而非开始。
distractorsZh: 终止生命过程对应相反操作。
表示处理语义状态变化。
生成操作不主张所有对象原本都活动。

questions.prompt: Why should an engineer examine the assumptions of a similarity measure before using it on a knowledge representation?
options: Cosine similarity is mathematically undefined for every embedding.
All similarity measures produce identical rankings.
The representation's structure never affects meaningful comparison.
A geometric score may miss relations or topology important to the task.
questions.explanationZh: 相似性应与任务和表征结构相匹配。余弦关注向量方向，图上的关系类型、路径和邻域可能承载额外语义；这不意味着余弦在所有任务都无效。
distractorsZh: 非零向量之间可正常计算余弦。
不同指标可能有不同排序。
结构可包含向量距离未保留的信息。

questions.prompt: A recommender increases engagement but narrows users' exposure and weakens their control. What is the best assessment?
options: Higher engagement proves every user's intention was fulfilled.
Trust can be measured entirely by click volume.
Engagement is a benefit-related metric, but trust also requires evaluating autonomy, diversity, and longer-term effects.
Personalization makes filter bubbles impossible.
questions.explanationZh: 理解用户意图不能只看表面行为。推荐可节省时间、改善体验并拓宽视野，也可能造成信息泡沫、成瘾和自主性下降；信任需要平衡这些影响。
distractorsZh: 参与度可能来自习惯或诱导，并不等于实现真实意图。
点击量遗漏自主性等重要维度。
个性化也可能缩窄信息范围。

questions.prompt: Which sequence moves from grammatical form to contextual communicative meaning?
options: Intention interpretation → spelling correction → token counting.
POS tagging → word-sense disambiguation → intention interpretation.
Personality recognition → stemming → sentence splitting.
Polarity scoring → punctuation deletion → character encoding.
questions.explanationZh: 词性等句法任务处理形式结构，词义等语义任务处理意义，意图及反讽等语用任务更依赖说话者和语境。各层会互相支持，并非完全独立。
distractorsZh: 该序列不是从形式逐步走向语境意图。
由人格退回词形和断句，方向相反。
后两步不构成语义到语用层次。

questions.prompt: A developer improves a simple classifier quickly at first, then needs richer context to fix the remaining difficult cases. What does this illustrate?
options: Higher-quality understanding can require disproportionately more linguistic and contextual capability.
Every one-percent improvement always has the same cost.
A fixed accuracy threshold universally defines understanding.
Easy examples are sufficient to characterize all remaining errors.
questions.explanationZh: 剩余错误往往涉及歧义、常识、意图及任务间依赖，因此质量提升可能越来越困难。应分析难例，不能把示意百分比当作所有任务的普适定律。
distractorsZh: 边际难度不必相同。
理解没有由一个固定准确率定义的通用边界。
难例往往与已解决的简单模式不同。

questions.prompt: Which pairing best distinguishes lexical semantics from cognitive semantics?
options: Lexical semantics studies word meanings and senses; cognitive semantics examines conceptual frames and situations.
Lexical semantics ignores words; cognitive semantics only counts characters.
Lexical semantics identifies sentence boundaries; cognitive semantics assigns file encodings.
Both are simply alternative names for pronunciation transcription.
questions.explanationZh: 词汇语义关注词义、歧义、词形成及对照关系；结构语义关注句法、语法与结构解释；认知语义关注框架、情景和概念化。
distractorsZh: 词与概念正是两者的核心内容。
断句和编码不是这两个领域的定义。
发音转写属于不同问题。

questions.prompt: An entity recognizer outputs structured entities that a dialogue system uses to interpret requests. What role does it play in this pipeline?
options: A replacement for the dialogue system's entire goal.
A guarantee of perfect end-to-end performance.
A dataset split rather than a processing component.
A parsing or structured-analysis component supplying interpretable units.
questions.explanationZh: 任务结果可作为下游特征、解析结构或解释依据。区分这些角色有助于理解“用于某下游任务”具体怎样发挥作用。
distractorsZh: 一个组件不等于完整系统。
结构化输出仍可能出错或不够充分。
此处描述模型功能而非数据划分。

refs.reasonZh: 下游中的特征、解析与解释
下游中的特征、解析与解释

questions.prompt: Which statement about methods across NLU tasks is most accurate?
options: Each model family can solve exactly one NLU task.
Choosing a neural method makes annotation conventions irrelevant.
Rule-based, statistical, and neural approaches can be adapted to different tasks, with task-specific inputs and outputs.
The same metric value means identical quality across every task.
questions.explanationZh: 方法家族在多个任务中复用，但标签结构、特征、监督信号和评价方式需适配任务。任务树和方法趋势图应按这种关系理解。
distractorsZh: CRF、Transformer 等可用于多种任务。
神经模型仍需要清楚定义输出标签。
不同任务、数据和指标不可只按数值比较。

questions.prompt: A team replaces only a lemmatizer in a modular system. Which validation is most useful?
options: Assume all downstream tasks improve automatically.
Check the lemmatizer's outputs and whether downstream behavior improves or regresses.
Skip interface checks because the component name is unchanged.
Evaluate only the size of the replacement model.
questions.explanationZh: 模块化便于独立更新、并行开发和定位错误，但替换后仍须检查输入输出约定、局部质量及整体效果，才能获得可靠性与可维护性收益。
distractorsZh: 局部改进不保证每个下游都受益。
同名组件也可能改变标签或规范。
规模不是功能质量的替代指标。

questions.prompt: A borrowed expression appears in many spellings that approximate the same pronunciation. Which evidence is especially useful for grouping the variants?
options: Phonetic similarity together with contextual evidence.
Only exact character equality.
Only the number of sentences in each document.
Only the final punctuation mark.
questions.explanationZh: 借词和口语转写可能出现大量拼写变体。发音相似度可以连接表面差异较大的形式，上下文则帮助排除同音但不同义的候选。
distractorsZh: 严格字符串相等无法连接不同拼写。
句子数通常不能识别发音关系。
标点不足以确定词语变体。

questions.prompt: A search engine maps 'colour' and 'color' to a shared form but also expands 'automobile' to 'car'. What is the distinction?
options: The first handles spelling variants; the second handles lexical synonyms.
Both operations necessarily perform sentence segmentation.
The first resolves pronouns; the second assigns grammatical gender.
The first is sentiment reversal; the second is causal inference.
questions.explanationZh: 拼写规范化将英美等书写变体统一；同义扩展建立不同词语之间的语义联系。两者都可改善检索，但依据不同。
distractorsZh: 两者处理词语形式或语义，不是断句。
不涉及代词先行词或性别语法。
不直接推断情感反转或因果。

questions.prompt: You need pronunciations of English vocabulary to score noisy spelling candidates. Which resource is the best fit?
options: A collection labeled only for sarcasm.
A Big Five personality inventory.
A sentence-level topic-classification label list.
A pronunciation lexicon such as CMUdict.
questions.explanationZh: 发音词典提供词与音素序列对应，可服务于语音相似候选生成。ARPABET 是音素编码体系，CMUdict 等是具体词典；CELEX 也包含词汇信息并涉及多种语言。
distractorsZh: 反讽标签没有直接给出词的发音。
人格问卷不编码发音条目。
主题标签不提供音素序列。

questions.prompt: A noisy token has two plausible normalizations with similar edit distance. What is a sensible next step?
options: Choose the candidate that comes first alphabetically in every case.
Treat equal edit distance as proof of equal meaning.
Use neighboring words and the intended meaning to rank the candidates.
Normalize every occurrence identically regardless of context.
questions.explanationZh: 字符串与发音相似度生成候选后，上下文可帮助判断哪个候选适合当前句意。规范化也可利用字符、音节和无标注文本信息。
distractorsZh: 字母顺序不是语义相关性依据。
相同编辑距离不代表语义相同。
一刀切替换会忽略歧义。

questions.prompt: A normalizer places the correct form second in a list of three candidates. How is this instance scored?
options: Correct under top-1 but incorrect under top-3.
Incorrect under top-1 accuracy, but correct under top-3 accuracy.
Incorrect under both because candidates are never evaluated.
Correct under both because any generated candidate counts as the first.
questions.explanationZh: Top-1 要求首选正确；Top-k 只要求正确答案出现在前 k 个候选中。因此扩大候选范围通常会提高覆盖，但不代表首选已经正确。
distractorsZh: Top-3 包含首位和第二位，不能出现该组合。
候选列表可以有明确定义的评价。
候选位置是评价条件的一部分。

questions.prompt: A reference has 20 words. An output contains 2 substitutions, 1 deletion, and 1 insertion. With WER = (S+D+I)/N, what is WER?
questions.explanationZh: WER=(2+1+1)/20=0.20。比较系统时还应考虑 SMS、社交媒体与正式新闻的分布差异，不能把不同测试集的分数直接当作同条件排名。
distractorsZh: 只计入替换，漏掉删除和插入。
少计入一种错误。
0.80 不是按给定公式得到的词错误率。

questions.prompt: In 'The office closed at 5 p.m. Tomorrow it opens early.', why is the period after 'p.m.' challenging for SBD?
options: It is part of an abbreviation and also coincides with a sentence boundary.
Abbreviations can never occur at the end of a sentence.
Every period inside a time expression must begin a new sentence.
The time expression has no bearing on boundary decisions.
questions.explanationZh: 同一个标点可以同时结束缩写和句子，不能简单规定“缩写中的点永不分句”。需结合后文结构和语境判断。
distractorsZh: 缩写完全可以位于句末。
内部缩写点未必是句界。
缩写结构正是判断歧义来源。

questions.prompt: A speech transcript lacks reliable punctuation. Which extra signal can help identify sentence boundaries?
options: Only the typography of a printed dictionary.
Only document-level sentiment labels.
Only alphabetical ordering of recognized words.
Pauses and intonation patterns from the audio.
questions.explanationZh: 语音场景可结合词汇、句法和韵律特征。停顿、语调等信息补充文本线索，但单一停顿也不一定是句界。
distractorsZh: 印刷字体不提供当前语音的韵律。
文档情绪标签不能精确定位句界。
排序会破坏原始序列。

refs.reasonZh: 语音断句中的韵律线索

questions.prompt: A POS tagger trained on edited news performs poorly on informal posts. Which explanation is plausible?
options: POS categories cannot be assigned to informal language.
Good news performance guarantees identical performance in every domain.
The posts contain different spelling, vocabulary, and syntactic patterns.
The only possible reason is a smaller label font.
questions.explanationZh: 正式语料、社交媒体和生物医学文本的分布可不同。WSJ、社交语料和 GENIA 等资源支持各自场景的评估，应核对目标领域。
distractorsZh: 口语和社交语言也可以进行词性标注。
领域偏移会影响泛化。
排版不是统计模型失配的核心解释。

questions.prompt: Why might character-level features help a POS tagger label a rare word?
options: Character features guarantee the word has only one possible POS.
Prefixes, suffixes, and internal spelling patterns can provide morphological clues.
They replace the need for every contextual clue.
They reveal the writer's personality label directly.
questions.explanationZh: 罕见词或未登录词的整词统计较弱，字符及形态线索可补充信息；上下文仍可能决定歧义词的实际词性。
distractorsZh: 同一形态可能对应多个词性。
上下文仍然重要。
词性特征不直接给出人格标签。

refs.reasonZh: 稀有词的字符与形态特征
稀有词的字符与形态特征

questions.prompt: A chunker considers the predicted labels of nearby tokens when selecting a noun-phrase span. Why can this help?
options: It can favor coherent label sequences and phrase boundaries.
It forces every sentence into one noun phrase.
It makes token order irrelevant.
It changes noun phrases into named-entity categories.
questions.explanationZh: 局部词汇、POS 与上下文特征可以结合前序 chunk 标签或全局结构，让边界更一致。浅层解析识别短语块，不必构建完整句法树。
distractorsZh: 句子可包含多个不同短语块。
标签依赖建立在序列位置之上。
短语类别与实体类型是不同标注目标。

refs.reasonZh: 词组边界与标签一致性
词组边界与标签一致性

questions.prompt: A system correctly tags every token's POS but groups a preposition into the wrong noun phrase. Which evaluation is needed to detect this error?
options: Chunk-span evaluation in addition to token-level POS accuracy.
Only checking whether words are spelled correctly.
Only measuring the number of tokens.
Only evaluating document sentiment.
questions.explanationZh: 正确词性并不保证正确短语分块；词元级准确率与跨度级精确率、召回率和 F1 衡量不同输出结构。
distractorsZh: 拼写检查不能检验短语边界。
词数不评价分组是否正确。
文档情绪与短语边界不直接相同。

questions.prompt: Why can aggressive suffix stripping harm sentiment analysis?
options: Every suffix is semantically empty in every language.
Removing more characters always preserves meaning better.
Sentiment depends only on word length.
It may merge forms with different meanings or connotations.
questions.explanationZh: 形式相似并不保证意义相同。过度去后缀可能把不同词义或情感内涵合并，因此归一化强度应结合下游目标。
distractorsZh: 后缀可能承载语法和词义信息。
删字符更多不等于语义更准确。
情绪并非由词长唯一决定。

questions.prompt: Which contrast is most relevant when deciding whether words should share a lemma?
options: All words sharing a prefix must have the same lemma.
Every noun and verb with related meaning must collapse to one POS.
Inflection changes grammatical form, while derivation can create a different lexical item.
A lemma is always the shortest possible character substring.
questions.explanationZh: 屈折形式通常对应同一词元；派生可改变词性或词汇意义。词干算法可能把相关词压到共同片段，而词元化往往需要词性和词典信息。
distractorsZh: 相同前缀不足以决定词元。
相关意义不代表同一词性或词元。
词元不是最短字符串定义。

questions.prompt: A stemmer has a suffix-removal rule that applies only when a morphological condition is satisfied. What should it do when that condition fails?
options: Remove the suffix whenever its letters match.
Leave that rule unapplied, even if the suffix text matches.
Discard the entire token.
Apply every suffix rule simultaneously without ordering.
questions.explanationZh: 规则词干器不仅匹配字符，还可能检验词干结构条件；规则的优先级、最长后缀和分阶段处理会影响结果。
distractorsZh: 字符匹配只是条件之一。
条件失败不要求删除整个词。
阶段和次序可避免冲突。

questions.prompt: A model converts an inflected character sequence into a lemma character sequence. Which formulation fits this operation?
options: Sequence transduction.
Document-level personality classification.
Sentence boundary detection alone.
Entity linking without any word-form transformation.
questions.explanationZh: 词元化可以建模为字符序列到字符序列的转换，也可采用规则、编辑脚本、统计转换与神经转换；上下文和形态标签帮助选择正确输出。
distractorsZh: 人格分类的输出不是词元字符序列。
断句只预测句界。
实体链接映射实体标识，目标不同。

questions.prompt: You want multilingual examples of inflected forms paired with lemmas and morphological information. Which resource family is most relevant?
options: Morphological resources such as UniMorph and lemmatization shared-task data.
Only a movie-review polarity lexicon.
Only a database of geographic coordinates.
Only an image-only facial-expression dataset.
questions.explanationZh: UniMorph、Universal Dependencies 以及 SIGMORPHON 等资源可支撑形态和词元相关研究；具体字段、语言和任务版本仍需检查。
distractorsZh: 情感词典通常不提供所需形态配对。
地理坐标不是词形标注。
图像表情数据不提供词元序列监督。

questions.prompt: A report gives average lemmatization accuracy over many languages. What should be inspected before concluding that the system works equally well on all of them?
options: Only the highest single-language score.
Only whether the average is printed with two decimal places.
Only the number of model layers.
Per-language results and the averaging scheme.
questions.explanationZh: 多语言平均值可能掩盖形态复杂度、数据量和领域带来的语言间差异。宏平均和按样本加权平均也有不同含义。
distractorsZh: 最高值不能代表所有语言。
小数位不说明各语言表现。
层数不能替代细分评估。

questions.prompt: The written word 'tear' can refer to liquid from an eye or to ripping something. What information is most useful for selecting the intended meaning in a sentence?
options: Its spelling alone, because spelling must uniquely determine sense.
A fixed rule assigning the most emotional meaning everywhere.
Its surrounding syntactic and semantic context.
The number of letters alone.
questions.explanationZh: 同形形式可能对应不同词义甚至不同发音。上下文、词性和搭配为消歧提供线索；仅凭拼写无法总是唯一确定意义。
distractorsZh: 同形异义正说明拼写不能唯一确定词义。
固定情绪偏好忽略语境。
词长不能区分同形词义。

questions.prompt: A WSD algorithm compares dictionary definitions with the target word's context and selects the sense with greatest overlap. Which approach is this?
options: A pure character edit-distance normalizer.
A Lesk-style knowledge-based method.
A sentence-boundary heuristic using periods only.
A personality classifier using questionnaire scores.
questions.explanationZh: Lesk 类方法利用词义释义与语境的重叠，属于知识驱动的词义消歧。释义为候选义提供外部语义信息。
distractorsZh: 编辑距离比较字符串形式，不比较词义释义。
句界检测不选择词义。
人格分数不提供词义释义重叠。

questions.prompt: Why can graph ranking help choose senses for several words in the same context?
options: It can favor senses connected coherently in a lexical knowledge graph.
It guarantees every word has exactly one dictionary sense.
It requires the words to have identical spelling.
It removes all semantic relations before ranking.
questions.explanationZh: 图式方法将候选义及其关系组织为图，利用连通性或 PageRank 类排序寻找语境中相互协调的解释。
distractorsZh: 词义数量由词汇资源决定，并不被算法强制为一。
相关词不必同形。
关系正是图排序的重要输入。

questions.prompt: A team has sense definitions but no labeled example sentences. What is missing for straightforward supervised WSD training?
options: Examples mapping word occurrences in context to gold sense labels.
Any distinction between words and characters.
A guarantee that the dictionary contains no ambiguous entries.
A requirement that all definitions have the same length.
questions.explanationZh: WordNet、FrameNet、BabelNet 等提供不同类型的词义或关系知识；SemCor 等提供带词义标注的实例。监督训练需要实例到标签的对应，而不仅是候选义清单。
distractorsZh: 词与字符区分不能代替监督实例。
词典记录歧义是正常且必要的。
释义等长不是监督条件。

refs.reasonZh: 消歧语料与词义知识库

questions.prompt: What is a potential benefit of combining a contextual neural encoder with a lexical knowledge graph for WSD?
options: Both components must contain exactly the same information.
The combination eliminates the need to define candidate senses.
Adding a graph guarantees perfect accuracy on unseen domains.
The encoder supplies usage context while the graph supplies explicit sense relations.
questions.explanationZh: 上下文表示与显式词义知识可互补，形成混合方法。知识资源的覆盖范围、领域适配和融合方式仍影响效果。
distractorsZh: 互补性正来自信息来源不同。
仍需明确要选择的词义集合或输出形式。
混合设计并不保证跨域完美。

questions.prompt: A translation system chooses the financial meaning of 'bank' in a sentence about a river. What can a WSD component directly improve?
options: The physical speed of the speaker's voice.
The number of pages in the source document.
The selection of the context-appropriate meaning before translation.
The document's font size.
questions.explanationZh: 错误词义会传给翻译、检索和情感分析等下游任务。显式消歧可提供特征、解析结果或解释依据，但仍需测试整体收益。
distractorsZh: 词义选择不直接改变语音速度。
页数不解决语义歧义。
排版不决定词义。

questions.prompt: Under BIOES tagging, how should a three-token entity be labeled when it is one complete span?
options: B, B, B
B, I, E
S, S, S
I, O, I
questions.explanationZh: B 表示开头，I 表示内部，E 表示结尾，S 表示独立单词实体，O 表示实体外部。三词完整跨度因此为 B-I-E。
distractorsZh: 三个 B 表示三个新跨度开头。
三个 S 表示三个独立单词实体。
O 会把中间词排除在实体之外。

questions.prompt: A text span names an organization that contains a location name inside it. Why might a single flat BIO sequence be insufficient?
options: It normally assigns one label per token and cannot directly express all overlapping nested spans.
Organizations and locations can never overlap in text.
BIO requires every entity to contain exactly one word.
Nested entities remove the need to predict boundaries.
questions.explanationZh: 嵌套 NER 需要同时表达内外层实体，单层标签序列通常不足。多层标注、跨度模型或超图等结构可表示多个层次。
distractorsZh: 组织名可以包含地名等内层实体。
BIO 可以表示多词实体。
每层跨度仍需要边界。

questions.prompt: A system asks a language model to complete 'X is a [MASK] entity' and maps 'person' to a label. What is the central idea?
options: Reformulate entity typing as a language-model prediction with a label mapping.
Replace entity typing with alphabetical sorting.
Assume a masked token automatically determines every possible entity boundary.
Require millions of newly labeled examples for the definition of few-shot learning.
questions.explanationZh: 提示方法利用预训练语言模型完成标签词预测，可用于少样本适配。实体跨度发现与类型映射仍需明确设计。
distractorsZh: 排序不进行实体类型推断。
边界与类型是相关但不同的步骤。
少样本恰强调有限的任务标注。

questions.prompt: A table-filling model predicts entity boundaries on some token pairs and relations on others. What is the intended benefit?
options: Treat relation labels as alternative spellings of entity names.
Produce relations without identifying their entity endpoints at any stage.
Turn every token pair into a separate sentence.
Represent entities and their relations within a shared structured prediction problem.
questions.explanationZh: 表填充可让实体跨度与实体间关系共享结构和特征，从而进行联合抽取。联合建模并非取消实体识别，而是使两个目标协同。
distractorsZh: 关系表示实体间联系，不是名称拼写。
关系端点仍需识别。
词对结构不改变句子单位定义。

questions.prompt: A recognizer needs terminology for diseases and medications. Which resource choice best matches this need?
options: Only a geographic gazetteer such as GeoNames.
Only a personality-trait questionnaire.
Medical resources such as UMLS, SNOMED CT, or DrugBank.
Only an informal-spelling normalization benchmark.
questions.explanationZh: 医学资源提供疾病、药物等领域知识；地理、金融与教育任务也可能选用不同专门知识库。标注语料与知识库分别提供学习实例和概念知识。
distractorsZh: 地名资源不覆盖所需医学术语主干。
人格问卷不提供医学实体知识。
规范化基准面向不同输出目标。

questions.prompt: A system labels 'Washington' as a location but has not chosen which real-world place it denotes. Which problem remains?
options: Whether the string contains any letters.
Entity disambiguation or linking to the intended referent.
Whether all locations must be people.
Whether every named entity is automatically the nearest pronoun's antecedent.
questions.explanationZh: 类型识别回答“属于哪类实体”，具体指向仍可能有歧义。NER 为指代、知识图谱、推荐和对话提供线索，但不独自完成所有语义推断。
distractorsZh: 这不解决名称所指。
地点与人物类型不能混为一谈。
指代还需语义和语境。

refs.reasonZh: 实体识别与实体消歧的界限
实体识别与实体消歧的界限

questions.prompt: Why should a concept extractor preserve 'get along with' as a unit in a sentence about relationships?
options: The phrase's meaning is not obtained by treating each word as an unrelated concept.
Every phrase containing 'get' expresses physical acquisition.
Function words never affect phrase meaning.
Multiword units must always be proper names.
questions.explanationZh: 多词表达和动词搭配可能具有整体意义；前后缀也可改变概念含义。概念抽取应保留这些语义组合。
distractorsZh: 不同搭配可有不同意义。
with 等功能词可决定搭配关系。
多词概念不必是专名。

questions.prompt: What is a risk of deleting all punctuation and stopwords before concept extraction?
options: It can destroy meaningful phrase boundaries, relations, or title expressions.
It always increases semantic precision.
It preserves every distinction expressed by hyphens.
It guarantees correct concept boundaries without context.
questions.explanationZh: 停用词、连字符、缩写点和大小写可能携带语义。规范化应按任务决定，避免把有意义的关系或名称机械删掉。
distractorsZh: 删词也可能降低精度。
连字符删除可能改变词组合。
边界仍需语言与语境线索。

refs.reasonZh: 预处理与结构信息损失
预处理与结构信息损失
预处理与结构信息损失

questions.prompt: An abstract contains an idea but not its conventional keyphrase. Which approach can produce that absent keyphrase?
options: A method strictly limited to selecting exact input spans.
A method that only marks sentence boundaries.
A method that only lowercases existing characters.
Generative keyphrase prediction.
questions.explanationZh: 抽取式方法选择文本中已有跨度；生成式方法能输出原文未显式出现的关键词，因此需要评估生成内容与文档是否一致。
distractorsZh: 严格抽取不能直接输出不存在的字符串。
断句不生成关键词。
小写转换不生成新概念表达。

refs.reasonZh: 抽取式与生成式关键词
抽取式与生成式关键词

questions.prompt: A model extracts course concepts from lecture descriptions. Why might domain-adapted resources help more than a generic keyword list?
options: Generic language never appears in course descriptions.
A domain resource makes every extraction automatically correct.
They represent the concepts and relations relevant to the educational domain.
Domain adaptation removes the need for evaluation.
questions.explanationZh: 临床、课程和专利等概念抽取有不同术语及结构。可用领域语料、百科或知识图谱提供上下文及关联，模型仍需评价。
distractorsZh: 领域文本仍包含普通语言。
资源也可能缺失或有歧义。
领域模型仍可能出错。

questions.prompt: One keyphrase system reports F1@5, while a structured concept parser reports a task-specific score on another dataset. What is needed for a fair ranking?
options: Sort the printed numbers regardless of metric.
A shared task definition, evaluation protocol, and comparable test data.
Assume the structured parser is better because it has a longer name.
Treat all scores as token accuracy.
questions.explanationZh: 不同输出与评价协议回答不同问题。F1@5 限定候选数量；结构化概念任务可能采用特有评价，不能直接按数值排序。
distractorsZh: 指标和数据不同会改变分数含义。
命名不决定性能。
F1、MAP 等不是 token accuracy 的别名。

questions.prompt: Why can gender and number agreement narrow antecedent candidates without always resolving a pronoun uniquely?
options: Several candidates may satisfy agreement, requiring semantics and world knowledge to choose among them.
Agreement always leaves exactly one candidate.
The nearest noun is necessarily correct.
World knowledge cannot affect reference interpretation.
questions.explanationZh: 形态一致性是筛选条件，而不是唯一性保证。多个候选兼容时，事件语义、常识、语篇焦点等继续发挥作用。
distractorsZh: 多个候选可能都一致。
距离启发式可能与语义冲突。
常识常帮助排除不合理先行词。

questions.prompt: A language allows a subject to be omitted when it is recoverable from context. What must a zero-pronoun resolver infer?
options: The unexpressed reference and its antecedent.
Only the pronunciation of the missing punctuation.
A new word sense for every visible noun.
That the sentence contains no participant.
questions.explanationZh: 零代词处理文本中未显式写出的指称。系统需借助句法和上下文恢复缺省参与者及其所指，不能仅扫描已出现的代词。
distractorsZh: 缺省主语不同于标点发音。
词义选择不是本题核心。
省略不意味着事件没有参与者。

questions.prompt: Which combination is suitable for developing a coreference system?
options: Only unlabeled spelling variants, with no mention structure.
Only sentiment intensity scores, with no reference examples.
Only a list of character encodings.
Annotated mention clusters for learning, plus lexical or commonsense knowledge for inference.
questions.explanationZh: OntoNotes、ARRAU、GAP 等提供不同形式的指代数据；WordNet、OMCS 及百科知识图可补充关系知识。两类资源作用不同。
distractorsZh: 规范化变体不足以监督指代簇。
情感分数不标明哪些提及同指。
字符编码不提供指称结构。

questions.prompt: What is a limitation of resolving every mention pair independently?
options: Pairwise decisions guarantee transitivity automatically.
Entity identity is unrelated to consistency among mentions.
Individually plausible pair decisions may produce inconsistent entity clusters.
A cluster can contain only one textual mention by definition.
questions.explanationZh: 共指关系最终涉及提及组成的实体簇。独立的局部判断可能不一致，提及排序、实体级或端到端建模可利用更完整结构。
distractorsZh: 独立预测未必保证传递一致性。
同一实体簇应保持身份一致。
一个实体通常可有多次提及。

questions.prompt: A coreference report defines its score as the mean of MUC, B³, and CEAF scores. Why is the metric definition important?
options: The mean must equal the number of correctly spelled tokens.
These metrics assess clustering in different ways, so the reported average is not ordinary token accuracy.
Each metric is merely a different name for sentiment recall.
A higher average proves every document's clusters are perfect.
questions.explanationZh: 共指评价关注提及簇结构；MUC、B³、CEAF 的计算角度不同。比较时应核对变体、提及设置及平均方式。
distractorsZh: 拼写 token 数与共指簇评价不同。
它们是共指评价指标。
平均分可掩盖局部错误。

refs.reasonZh: 共指评价中的组合指标

questions.prompt: Why can a single sentiment score near zero be ambiguous?
options: It may represent little emotion or a balance of strong positive and negative reactions.
It always proves the text is objectively factual.
It always means the text contains no opinion.
It uniquely determines the speaker's personality.
questions.explanationZh: 正负情绪作为两个维度时，双低是中性，双高可能是矛盾情绪。压缩成单一差值会丢失这种区别。
distractorsZh: 近零不必客观，可能正负相抵。
矛盾情绪仍包含强烈意见。
一句话的情感不能唯一确定人格。

questions.prompt: A word is subjective in one sense but descriptive in another. What can improve subjectivity detection?
options: Sense and surrounding-context information.
Assigning it one permanent subjectivity label in every occurrence.
Ignoring all neighboring sentences.
Treating every adjective as subjective and every noun as objective.
questions.explanationZh: 词典线索可提供先验，但词义、语篇与上下文会改变用法。主观性词义消歧及语境相关模型可减少固定词表误判。
distractorsZh: 固定标签忽略词义和语境。
邻近语篇可能提供判断线索。
词性不是主观性的完美分界。

questions.prompt: An English subjectivity corpus is machine-translated for another language. What should be checked?
options: That every translated label is automatically noise-free.
That source-language word order must remain unchanged.
That target-language evaluation is unnecessary.
Whether translation preserves subjective cues and whether the target-language data distribution is suitable.
questions.explanationZh: 跨语言资源可扩大训练材料，但翻译可能改变情感、模态或表达方式。需要验证标签保持情况并在目标语言评价。
distractorsZh: 机器翻译可能带来标签或表达噪声。
自然翻译通常需适应目标语序。
迁移效果必须在目标条件下测试。

questions.prompt: A meeting statement sounds hesitant despite neutral wording. Which design can use this evidence?
options: A model restricted to a bag of written words.
A rule that all neutral wording implies neutral delivery.
A multimodal model combining textual and prosodic cues.
A model that discards audio before all analysis.
questions.explanationZh: 多模态主观性可利用词汇、韵律、音素及视觉信息。不同模态可能互补，也需处理对齐和缺失模态问题。
distractorsZh: 只保留词袋无法直接利用语调。
措辞中性不保证表达方式中性。
删除音频会丢失题设线索。

questions.prompt: A system detects biased wording in encyclopedia edits. Why is a general positive/negative lexicon insufficient by itself?
options: Biased wording must contain a swear word.
Bias can arise from framing, selection, or attribution even without overtly emotional words.
Every negative statement is necessarily biased.
Objective-looking grammar guarantees impartial content.
questions.explanationZh: 偏差检测与主观性、极性相关但不等价。词汇、POS、LIWC 类心理语言特征和语境模型都可提供线索；偏差仍可能藏在叙述框架中。
distractorsZh: 偏差不要求粗俗用语。
准确的负面事实也可以不带偏差。
语法客观不保证选材和框架中立。

questions.prompt: A system marks 'grasp' as metaphorical in 'grasp the idea' but provides no intended meaning. What remains to be done?
options: Interpret the metaphor, such as paraphrasing it as understanding the idea.
Only count the letters in the marked word.
Assume identification already provides a complete explanation.
Translate each character independently.
questions.explanationZh: 识别定位隐喻表达，解释则恢复其语境意义。流程可结合多词表达识别、释义或义项配对，再把解释整合回句子。
distractorsZh: 字符计数不提供语义解释。
知道哪里是隐喻不等于知道表达何意。
字符级翻译不解决整体意义。

questions.prompt: In 'Her argument is a fragile bridge', what should a useful metaphor interpretation transfer?
options: Relevant properties such as instability or weak support, selected by context.
Every physical property of an actual bridge without selection.
The literal claim that the argument is made of construction materials.
Only the grammatical number of 'bridge'.
questions.explanationZh: 隐喻解释选择源域中与目标域相关的属性，而非逐项搬运全部字面特征。属性提取与概念隐喻处理服务于这种映射。
distractorsZh: 无选择地转移全部属性通常产生荒谬解释。
字面物质身份不是隐喻意图。
单纯数一致不解释隐喻内容。

questions.prompt: Why can an unexpected semantic combination, such as an abstract idea being physically swallowed, signal a metaphor?
options: Every unusual combination must be a spelling error.
Selectional preferences forbid all figurative language.
Only noun capitalization can indicate metaphor.
It may violate the verb's usual selectional preferences under a literal reading.
questions.explanationZh: 选择偏好描述谓词通常与哪些语义类型的论元搭配。字面解读下的不协调可提示隐喻，但仍需语境排除其他解释。
distractorsZh: 不寻常表达也可能有连贯的比喻意义。
偏好是分析线索，不是禁令。
隐喻不依赖专名大写。

questions.prompt: A metaphor system generates a literal paraphrase. Which evaluation most directly tests the quality of that output?
options: Whether it contains the same number of letters as the input.
Whether every original word remains unchanged.
Whether the paraphrase preserves the intended contextual meaning and is coherent.
Whether it uses only words with the highest corpus frequency.
questions.explanationZh: 隐喻释义需评价意义保持、适切性、可接受性与连贯性。词义词典、框架和常识知识能辅助解释，但候选解释仍要结合语境判断。
distractorsZh: 长度相同不保证意义相同。
释义通常会改写用词。
高频词不能保证表达准确。

questions.prompt: Why can literal translation fail on figurative expressions?
options: All metaphors have identical literal equivalents in every language.
It can preserve surface words while losing the intended conceptual meaning.
A POS tag alone supplies every culturally appropriate interpretation.
Correct tokenization guarantees correct figurative translation.
questions.explanationZh: 隐喻理解可支持翻译、情感、心理认知及政治话语分析。不同下游可能把它作为解析或解释模块，语言与文化背景仍重要。
distractorsZh: 不同语言的惯用隐喻不必相同。
词性不能提供完整文化解释。
分词正确只是前置条件之一。

questions.prompt: A sarcastic reply appears polite in isolation but contradicts the preceding conversation. Which model input is most useful?
options: The reply together with the relevant conversational context.
Only the reply's isolated positive words.
Only the total number of messages in the platform.
Only a dictionary's alphabetical order.
questions.explanationZh: 反讽常依赖说话内容与情境的不一致。分别编码内容和上下文并进行融合，可让模型利用这类关系。
distractorsZh: 孤立正面词可能给出相反判断。
总消息量不提供具体对话语义。
字母顺序没有语用关系。

refs.reasonZh: 内容与语境的反讽融合

questions.prompt: You want to study sarcasm conveyed through words, voice, facial expression, and prior turns. What kind of dataset is needed?
options: Aligned conversational text, audio, video, and sarcasm annotations.
Only isolated word-polarity entries.
Only sentence lengths and timestamps without content.
Only a morphological dictionary.
questions.explanationZh: 多模态反讽需要可对齐的目标表达及上下文，并结合文本、声学和视觉信号。情境、说话方式和表情可能提供字面文字之外的线索。
distractorsZh: 词级极性无法保留多模态交互。
元数据缺少所需语义和表达证据。
形态词典不包含反讽对话。

refs.reasonZh: 多模态证据与数据选择

questions.prompt: A positive caption accompanies an obviously unpleasant scene. What is the safest interpretation?
options: Every text-image mismatch is certainly sarcastic.
A positive word guarantees positive communicative intent.
Visual information must always be ignored.
The contrast is evidence for possible sarcasm, but context is still needed.
questions.explanationZh: 图文情感或语义不一致可触发反讽候选，但也可能是错误配图、引用或其他修辞。检测应综合证据，而非把不一致当充分条件。
distractorsZh: 不一致还有其他成因。
字面积极可能服务于反讽。
图像恰可能补充关键语境。

refs.reasonZh: 图文不一致与非必然性

questions.prompt: A sarcasm detector measures the conflict between an event's negative implications and an explicitly positive evaluation. Which cue is it modeling?
options: Morphological agreement alone.
A document's character encoding.
Semantic incongruity.
Only the speaker's chronological age.
questions.explanationZh: 语义不协调方法显式关注内容或情感间的冲突；其他方法还可利用人工特征、嵌入及上下文。不同来源线索可以组合。
distractorsZh: 形态一致并非事件与评价之间的语义冲突。
字符编码不表示反讽关系。
年龄不能替代句子语义证据。

refs.reasonZh: 语义不协调与特征建模

questions.prompt: A sentiment system consistently treats sarcastic praise as sincere praise. Which component would most directly address the error?
options: A longer list of positive synonyms alone.
A sarcasm-aware interpretation stage using context before final polarity assignment.
A rule deleting every positive adjective.
A rule treating every compliment as negative.
questions.explanationZh: 反讽检测可纠正字面极性与真实意图的错位，并用于对话、心理状态相关分析和广告分析。结合语境比无差别翻转情感更可靠。
distractorsZh: 更多积极词仍可能强化误判。
删除全部积极形容词会损害真诚表达。
并非所有赞美都是反讽。

refs.reasonZh: 反讽对下游任务的影响

questions.prompt: A person writes one anxious message. Why is it risky to infer their stable personality directly from that message?
options: A temporary emotional state and a stable trait are different constructs.
Every anxious sentence proves the same personality profile.
Personality cannot influence language in any way.
The message's polarity completely specifies all five traits.
questions.explanationZh: 人格特质描述较稳定倾向，单次表达可能受情境和暂时状态影响。外向、尽责、开放、宜人及神经质等维度不能由一句情绪化文本直接确定。
distractorsZh: 一次状态不足以建立稳定画像。
人格可与语言倾向相关，但关系需证据。
情感极性与五维特质不同。

refs.reasonZh: 特质与单次情绪的区别
特质与单次情绪的区别

questions.prompt: A questionnaire describes someone as organized, reliable, and persistent. Which Big Five dimension is most directly indicated?
options: Conscientiousness.
Extraversion.
Neuroticism.
Openness alone.
questions.explanationZh: 尽责性关注组织性、可靠性和坚持；外向性偏向活跃社交，神经质偏向情绪敏感或焦虑，开放性偏向好奇与新体验。
distractorsZh: 组织可靠并不直接定义外向社交。
这些特征并非焦虑或敏感。
好奇新体验不同于组织与自律。

questions.prompt: In the MBTI framework, which contrast best matches Judging versus Perceiving?
options: Logical analysis versus values-oriented judgment.
Outer-world orientation versus inner-world orientation.
Sensory detail versus pattern-oriented intuition.
Preference for closure and planning versus flexibility and spontaneity.
questions.explanationZh: J/P 关注处理外部世界时偏好的组织与开放方式。T/F 区分判断偏好，E/I 区分能量导向，S/N 区分信息感知偏好；这些是该框架中的术语。
distractorsZh: 这是 T/F 的对比。
这是 E/I 的对比。
这是 S/N 的对比。

terms.zh: 迈尔斯—布里格斯类型指标

questions.prompt: A trait score averages two responses on a 1–7 scale. The first is 6; the second is 2 and must be reverse-scored as 8−x. What is the trait score?
questions.explanationZh: 反向得分为 8−2=6，再与第一题 6 求平均，得到 6。反向题让措辞相反的条目按同一特质方向计分；应先反向再汇总。
distractorsZh: 4 是忘记反向后直接平均的结果。
2 是未处理的单个原始回答。
计算结果并非量表最大值。

questions.prompt: A dataset contains many posts per person. How should a test split be designed to assess generalization to unseen people?
options: Randomly split posts so the same person appears in training and test.
Keep each person's posts entirely within one split.
Put each person's earliest and latest posts in different splits by default.
Duplicate frequent users across every split to stabilize scores.
questions.explanationZh: 如果同一人的文本同时出现在训练和测试中，模型可能利用作者特定线索。评估新用户泛化需用户级划分，并区分各特质分类、相关系数和其他指标。
distractorsZh: 同作者跨集合可能造成泄漏。
单纯按帖子时间不能保证未见用户条件。
复制用户强化泄漏。

refs.reasonZh: 用户级分割与人格评价
用户级分割与人格评价

questions.prompt: A review says, 'It fits easily into my jacket pocket' without naming size. Which task is needed to recover the implied product aspect?
options: Implicit aspect extraction.
Only matching explicit occurrences of the word 'size'.
Only classifying the whole review as spam.
Only extracting the author's name.
questions.explanationZh: 尺寸通过可放进口袋的描述被间接表达。显式方面有直接词语跨度，隐式方面需从语义或常识推断类别。
distractorsZh: 原文没有直接出现该词，纯匹配会漏掉。
垃圾信息分类不是方面识别。
作者实体与产品方面不同。

questions.prompt: A review mentions 'touchscreen', assigns it to DISPLAY, and calls it excellent. Which output is the aspect category?
options: DISPLAY.
touchscreen.
positive.
The full review length.
questions.explanationZh: 方面术语是原文表达，方面类别是归纳标签，极性是评价方向。AE、AC、ATP、ACP 分别涉及术语抽取、类别识别及两种粒度的极性判断。
distractorsZh: touchscreen 是术语跨度。
positive 是极性。
长度不是语义类别。

refs.reasonZh: 术语、类别与极性的区别

questions.prompt: Two products have equal overall ratings but opposite strengths in battery life and picture quality. What is lost by using only the overall rating?
options: The fact that either product exists.
Every possible grammatical label.
The exact spelling of the product name.
The aspect-specific trade-offs needed for different user preferences.
questions.explanationZh: 整体平均可能掩盖不同方面的优劣。方面级比较把相同总分背后的结构展开，支持根据用户偏好做选择。
distractorsZh: 实体存在不由评分聚合决定。
词性标注不是比较重点。
名称拼写可独立保留。

questions.prompt: An opinion miner outputs (battery life, lasts all day, positive). What advantage does this structured output have over a sentence-level polarity label?
options: It removes all need to locate the opinion target.
It guarantees that every other aspect is positive.
It connects a target aspect, supporting opinion expression, and polarity.
It expresses only whether the sentence is grammatical.
questions.explanationZh: 联合输出可以绑定方面、意见和极性，减少“评价指向哪个对象”的歧义。不同任务还可能加入方面类别等字段。
distractorsZh: 该输出恰显式定位目标。
其他方面可能有不同评价。
结构描述语义评价而非语法正确性。

questions.prompt: How can a knowledge base help identify an implied aspect and its sentiment?
options: Every knowledge-graph edge must encode a positive opinion.
Concept relations can connect an expression to an aspect, while sentiment knowledge can inform its evaluation.
A knowledge base eliminates all need for sentence context.
A larger entity count guarantees correct aspect boundaries.
questions.explanationZh: 常识关系可支持由表达推断方面；情感词典或知识图提供极性信息。Probase、通用实体图和情感知识资源的作用不同，需结合句内依赖及语境。
distractorsZh: 知识关系不一定是情感关系。
语境决定当前用法。
规模不能保证跨度预测正确。

refs.reasonZh: 情感与常识知识的互补
情感与常识知识的互补

questions.prompt: A sentiment regressor predicts 0.2 for a gold intensity of −0.4. What is the absolute error?
questions.explanationZh: 绝对误差为 |0.2−(−0.4)|=0.6。连续强度评价可用 MAE 等误差指标，分类任务则常用准确率或 F1。
distractorsZh: 绝对误差不为负。
0.2 只是预测值。
0.08 是乘积绝对值，不是差值绝对值。

questions.prompt: A polarity model combines contextual embeddings with explicit rules about negation and semantic relations. Which approach does this illustrate?
options: Neurosymbolic modelling.
A purely context-free lookup with no learned representation.
A pronunciation-only model.
An approach that forbids all symbolic structure.
questions.explanationZh: 神经符号方法融合神经表示与显式知识或逻辑约束，可包括依存、规则、词典、常识和逻辑张量网络等组合。
distractorsZh: 题设包含上下文嵌入和规则。
其目标是语义极性而非发音。
显式结构正是该组合的一部分。

questions.prompt: Why might a contextual language model improve on a fixed sentiment lexicon for some sentences?
options: It guarantees perfect handling of every domain and negation.
It never uses information learned from text.
A lexicon is incapable of providing any useful sentiment knowledge.
It can condition the interpretation on surrounding words and composition.
questions.explanationZh: 上下文模型可捕捉词义、否定与组合关系；词典提供可解释的先验。预训练、提示和知识融合各有优势，并不存在不经评估的全面保证。
distractorsZh: 预训练模型也会产生领域和推理错误。
其能力通常依赖文本训练。
词典仍可作为基线、特征或知识源。

questions.prompt: A robot detects frustration in a user's utterance. What is a reasonable role for that output?
options: Treat the detected emotion as an unquestionable command.
Assume every frustrated utterance has the same cause.
Use it as one input when selecting an appropriate response, alongside task and safety context.
Replace the entire dialogue state with a single polarity score.
questions.explanationZh: 情感分析可支持人机交互和推荐，但单个情绪结果并不等于用户真实目的或完整状态。下游应结合其他证据，并考虑识别误差。
distractorsZh: 情绪判断不是行动授权。
原因随语境而异。
单一分数丢失意图、对象和任务信息。

questions.prompt: A study uses news sentiment as a feature for forecasting a financial time series. What does successful prediction alone demonstrate?
options: A guaranteed profitable investment strategy.
Predictive usefulness under the evaluated conditions, not proof that sentiment causes every price movement.
A complete causal explanation of market behavior.
That future performance cannot change.
questions.explanationZh: 极性结果可作为推荐、金融预测或组合配置等模型的特征，也可提供解释线索。预测关联的证据范围不同于因果证明或未来收益保证。
distractorsZh: 测试预测成绩不保证投资获利。
市场因果机制需要额外论证。
数据分布和关系可能变化。

refs.reasonZh: 情感预测的应用与因果边界
